definitions.explanation: A room or small building set apart from the main house on the same grounds, used for guests, a study, an elderly parent, or as a separate suite at a traditional inn.

examples.japanese: {離|はな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: To stay in the detached annex.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{離|はな}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lives in the annex.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離|はな}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That inn has three detached suites, each with its own open-air bath.

notes:
From {離|はな}れる (to be apart). Often {離|はな}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ or, more formally, {離|はな}れ⟦{座敷|ざしき}→座敷：00433_zashiki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離|はな}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a detached room
- {離|はな}れ⟦{座敷|ざしき}→座敷：00433_zashiki⟧: a detached tatami room, often for guests
- {離|はな}れ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a house with an annex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {母屋|おもや}: the main house, the counterpart of {離|はな}れ
- 〜{離|ばな}れ: a suffix meaning a falling away from something (⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車離|くるまばな}れ, young people losing interest in cars)
